WITH high_schools_with_grade12_enroll AS (
  SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSserved, s.StatusType
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND (',' || s.GSserved || ',' LIKE '%,12,%')
),
sat_takers_by_school AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.cds, SUM(ss.NumTstTakr) AS total_sat_takers
  FROM satscores ss
  GROUP BY ss.cds
),
schools_no_sat AS (
  SELECT 
    hs.CDSCode, hs.School, hs.GSserved
  FROM high_schools_with_grade12_enroll hs
  LEFT JOIN sat_takers_by_school st ON hs.CDSCode = st.cds
  WHERE IFNULL(st.total_sat_takers, 0) = 0
),
school_grades_extracted AS (
  SELECT 
    cds, School,
    TRIM(SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, ',')-1)) AS first_grade,
    GSserved
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      CDSCode AS cds, School, GSserved,
      CASE 
        WHEN INSTR(GSserved, ',') = 0 THEN GSserved || ','
        ELSE GSserved
      END AS GSserved2
    FROM schools_no_sat
  )
),
grade_for_sort AS (
  SELECT 
    cds, School, first_grade, GSserved,
    CASE 
      WHEN first_grade = 'PS' THEN 0
      WHEN first_grade = 'PK' THEN 1
      WHEN first_grade = 'TK' THEN 2
      WHEN first_grade = 'KG' THEN 3
      WHEN CAST(first_grade AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 4
      WHEN CAST(first_grade AS INTEGER) > 1 THEN 3 + CAST(first_grade AS INTEGER)
      ELSE 100
    END AS sort_grade
  FROM school_grades_extracted
)
SELECT School AS school_name, GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM grade_for_sort
WHERE sort_grade = (SELECT MIN(sort_grade) FROM grade_for_sort)
ORDER BY school_name;

WITH active_charters AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        FundingType,
        COALESCE(GSserved, GSoffered) AS Grades,
        StatusType,
        Charter
    FROM schools
    WHERE
        Charter = 1
        AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Open')
        AND FundingType IN ('Directly Funded', 'Locally Funded')
),
charters_with_demo AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.FundingType,
        s.StatusType,
        s.Charter,
        -- Enrollment based on K-12: count if GSserved/GSoffered cover grades K-12 (or using a proxy if exact grade span column not provided)
        CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS enroll_k12_2014_15,
        NULL AS frpm_percent_2014_15
    FROM active_charters s
),
sat_score_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sc.FundingType,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sc.CDSCode) AS num_schools,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN c.enroll_k12_2014_15 IS NOT NULL THEN c.enroll_k12_2014_15
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_enrollment,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN c.frpm_percent_2014_15 IS NOT NULL THEN c.frpm_percent_2014_15
            END
        ) AS avg_frpm_percent,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
                THEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite)
            END
        ) AS avg_sat_total
    FROM schools sc
    LEFT JOIN charters_with_demo c
        ON sc.CDSCode = c.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN satscores s
        ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
        AND s.rtype = 'S'
    WHERE sc.Charter = 1
      AND sc.StatusType IN ('Active', 'Open')
      AND sc.FundingType IN ('Directly Funded', 'Locally Funded')
    GROUP BY sc.FundingType
)
SELECT
    FundingType,
    num_schools,
    total_enrollment,
    ROUND(avg_frpm_percent, 2) AS avg_frpm_percent,
    ROUND(avg_sat_total, 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM sat_score_agg
ORDER BY FundingType;

WITH closed_schools_with_scores AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS name,
    s.District AS district,
    s.County AS county,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
  WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
    AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
score_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_writing DESC) AS writing_rank
  FROM closed_schools_with_scores
),
score_levels AS (
  SELECT
    avg_writing,
    writing_rank
  FROM score_ranks
  GROUP BY avg_writing, writing_rank
  ORDER BY avg_writing DESC
)
SELECT
  sr.name,
  sr.district,
  sr.county,
  sr.avg_writing
FROM score_ranks sr
JOIN (
  SELECT avg_writing
  FROM score_levels
  WHERE writing_rank = 2
) runnerup ON sr.avg_writing = runnerup.avg_writing
ORDER BY sr.name;

WITH fremont_county AS (
  SELECT County AS county_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
target_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    f.CDSCode, 
    f.[County Name] AS county_name, 
    f.[School Type], 
    f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] AS free_meals, 
    f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS frpm_meals,
    ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)], 2) AS pct_free, 
    ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)], 2) AS pct_frpm,
    f.[Charter School (Y/N)] AS charter_ind
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN fremont_county fc ON f.[County Name] = fc.county_name
  WHERE f.[School Type] = 'K-12'
    AND f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] > 500
    AND f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] < 700
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT county_name, COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
         ROUND(AVG(pct_free), 2) AS avg_free_pct,
         ROUND(AVG(pct_frpm), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
         SUM(CASE WHEN charter_ind = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter,
         SUM(CASE WHEN charter_ind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter
  FROM target_schools
),
sat_by_school AS (
  SELECT t.CDSCode, 
         (COALESCE(s.AvgScrRead,0) + COALESCE(s.AvgScrMath,0) + COALESCE(s.AvgScrWrite,0)) AS total_sat
  FROM target_schools t
  JOIN satscores s ON t.CDSCode = s.cds 
  WHERE s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
avg_sat AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_sat), 2) AS avg_sat_score FROM sat_by_school
)
SELECT a.county_name, a.num_schools, a.avg_free_pct, a.avg_frpm_pct, a.num_charter, a.num_non_charter, s.avg_sat_score
FROM avgs a CROSS JOIN avg_sat s;

WITH county_cds AS (
  SELECT s.County, f."County Code"
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.CDSCode = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
qualified_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    f.CDSCode,
    f."County Name" AS County,
    f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] AS free_meal_cnt,
    f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS frpm_cnt,
    ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)], 2) AS free_pct,
    ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)], 2) AS frpm_pct,
    f.[Charter School (Y/N)] AS is_charter
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN county_cds c ON f."County Name" = c.County
  WHERE f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] > 500
    AND f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] < 700
    AND (
      (LOWER(f.[Low Grade]) IN ('kg','k','pk','tk','p') OR CAST(f.[Low Grade] AS INTEGER) <= 1)
      AND (UPPER(f.[High Grade]) IN ('12', '12TH', 'GRADE 12') OR CAST(f.[High Grade] AS INTEGER) = 12)
    )
),
sat_school_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    s.cds,
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS sat_total
  FROM satscores s
  WHERE s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  qs.County AS county_name,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(qs.free_pct),2) AS avg_free_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(qs.frpm_pct),2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qs.is_charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qs.is_charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter,
  ROUND(AVG(ss.sat_total),2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM qualified_schools qs
LEFT JOIN sat_school_scores ss ON ss.cds = qs.CDSCode

WITH eligible_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.GSserved,
    s.Charter,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS free_meal_rate
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] IS NOT NULL
),
max_frpm AS (
  SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS max_rate FROM eligible_schools
),
tied_schools AS (
  SELECT
    es.CDSCode,
    es.school_name,
    ROUND(es.free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE es.Charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS is_charter_school,
    es.GSserved AS grades_served
  FROM eligible_schools es
  JOIN max_frpm m ON es.free_meal_rate = m.max_rate
)
SELECT
  t.school_name,
  t.free_meal_rate,
  t.is_charter_school,
  t.grades_served,
  CASE 
    WHEN ss.AvgScrRead IS NULL AND ss.AvgScrMath IS NULL AND ss.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    ELSE CASE 
      WHEN (IFNULL(ss.AvgScrRead,0) + IFNULL(ss.AvgScrMath,0) + IFNULL(ss.AvgScrWrite,0))/3.0 < 
        (SELECT AVG(totalavg) FROM (SELECT (IFNULL(AvgScrRead,0)+IFNULL(AvgScrMath,0)+IFNULL(AvgScrWrite,0))/3.0 AS totalavg FROM satscores WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL OR AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL OR AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN (IFNULL(ss.AvgScrRead,0) + IFNULL(ss.AvgScrMath,0) + IFNULL(ss.AvgScrWrite,0))/3.0 > 
        (SELECT AVG(totalavg) FROM (SELECT (IFNULL(AvgScrRead,0)+IFNULL(AvgScrMath,0)+IFNULL(AvgScrWrite,0))/3.0 AS totalavg FROM satscores WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL OR AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL OR AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'Above Average'
      ELSE 'Average'
    END
  END AS sat_performance
FROM tied_schools t
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON t.CDSCode = ss.cds
GROUP BY t.CDSCode, t.school_name, t.free_meal_rate, t.is_charter_school, t.grades_served

LIMIT 1000

WITH exclusively_virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT
    County,
    School,
    CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE LOWER(Virtual) = 'exclusively virtual'
),
county_virtual_counts AS (
  SELECT
    County,
    COUNT(*) AS exclusively_virtual_count
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools
  GROUP BY County
),
limits AS (
  SELECT exclusively_virtual_count
  FROM county_virtual_counts
  ORDER BY exclusively_virtual_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT MIN(exclusively_virtual_count) AS cutoff
  FROM limits
),
top_counties AS (
  SELECT cvc.County, cvc.exclusively_virtual_count
  FROM county_virtual_counts cvc
  CROSS JOIN threshold t
  WHERE cvc.exclusively_virtual_count >= t.cutoff
),
school_with_scores AS (
  SELECT
    evs.County,
    evs.School,
    evs.CDSCode,
    ss.AvgScrRead
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools evs
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss
    ON evs.CDSCode = ss.cds AND ss.rtype = 'S'
),
ranked_schools AS (
  SELECT
    sws.County,
    sws.School,
    sws.AvgScrRead,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sws.County ORDER BY sws.AvgScrRead DESC)
      AS reading_rank
  FROM school_with_scores sws
  WHERE sws.County IN (SELECT County FROM top_counties)
),
top_school_in_county AS (
  SELECT
    County,
    GROUP_CONCAT(School, ', ') AS top_school_name
  FROM ranked_schools
  WHERE reading_rank = 1 AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY County
),
counties_with_score AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT County FROM top_school_in_county
),
counties_no_reported_scores AS (
  SELECT tc.County
  FROM top_counties tc
  LEFT JOIN counties_with_score cws ON tc.County = cws.County
  WHERE cws.County IS NULL
)
SELECT
  tc.County,
  tc.exclusively_virtual_count,
  COALESCE(tsic.top_school_name, 'None') AS top_school_name
FROM top_counties tc
LEFT JOIN top_school_in_county tsic ON tc.County = tsic.County
ORDER BY tc.exclusively_virtual_count DESC, tc.County;

WITH exclusively_virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        School,
        CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE lower(Virtual) = 'exclusively virtual'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        COUNT(*) AS num_virtual_schools
    FROM exclusively_virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        num_virtual_schools,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC) AS rnk
    FROM county_counts
),
top_counties AS (
    SELECT County, num_virtual_schools
    FROM ranked_counts
    WHERE rnk <= (
        SELECT rnk FROM (
            SELECT rnk
            FROM ranked_counts
            ORDER BY rnk DESC
            LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4
        )
    )
),
virtual_schools_with_sat AS (
    SELECT
        evs.County,
        evs.School,
        evs.CDSCode,
        s.AvgScrRead
    FROM exclusively_virtual_schools evs
    LEFT JOIN satscores s ON evs.CDSCode = s.cds AND s.rtype = 'S'
),
max_reading_per_county AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        MAX(AvgScrRead) AS max_reading
    FROM virtual_schools_with_sat
    WHERE County IN (SELECT County FROM top_counties)
    GROUP BY County
),
top_schools_per_county AS (
    SELECT
        v.County,
        v.School,
        v.AvgScrRead
    FROM virtual_schools_with_sat v
    INNER JOIN max_reading_per_county mrc
        ON v.County = mrc.County
        AND (
            (v.AvgScrRead = mrc.max_reading AND mrc.max_reading IS NOT NULL)
            OR (v.AvgScrRead IS NULL AND mrc.max_reading IS NULL)
        )
    WHERE v.County IN (SELECT County FROM top_counties)
),
final_output AS (
    SELECT
        tc.County,
        tc.num_virtual_schools,
        COALESCE(ts.school_names, 'None') AS top_school_name
    FROM top_counties tc
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT County, GROUP_CONCAT(School, '; ') AS school_names
        FROM top_schools_per_county
        WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY County
        UNION ALL
        SELECT v.County, 'None' AS school_names
        FROM virtual_schools_with_sat v
        WHERE v.County IN (SELECT County FROM top_counties)
        GROUP BY v.County
        HAVING MAX(v.AvgScrRead) IS NULL
    ) ts ON tc.County = ts.County
)
SELECT County, num_virtual_schools, top_school_name
FROM final_output
ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC, County;

    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County,
    s.City,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailState,
    s.MailZip,
    s.Website,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12enroll,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_num_eligible,
    CASE WHEN f."Enrollment (K-12)" != 0 THEN f."FRPM Count (K-12)"/f."Enrollment (K-12)" ELSE NULL END AS frpm_share,

  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE
    f."School Type" = 'Regular'
    AND (f."Charter School (Y/N)" IS NULL OR f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0)
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
),
sat_joined AS (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    sat.NumTstTakr,
    sat.NumGE1500,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    (CAST(sat.AvgScrRead AS FLOAT) + CAST(sat.AvgScrMath AS FLOAT) + CAST(sat.AvgScrWrite AS FLOAT)) AS avg_total_sat,
    CASE WHEN sat.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr ELSE NULL END AS pct_1500_or_more
  FROM eligible_schools e
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON e.cdscode = sat.cds AND sat.rtype = 'S'
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, cdscode FROM sat_joined WHERE frpm_num_eligible = (SELECT MAX(frpm_num_eligible) FROM sat_joined)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'smallest FRPM share' AS part, cdscode FROM sat_joined WHERE frpm_share = (SELECT MIN(frpm_share) FROM sat_joined)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes' AS part, cdscode FROM sat_joined WHERE cdscode = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
  x.part,
  s.school_name,
  s.County,
  s.City,
  s.MailStreet,
  s.MailCity,
  s.MailState,
  s.MailZip,
  s.Website,
  s.k12enroll,
  s.frpm_num_eligible,
  s.frpm_share,
  s.avg_total_sat,
  s.pct_1500_or_more,
  s.OpenDate,
  s.status
FROM extremes x
JOIN sat_joined s ON x.cdscode = s.cdscode
ORDER BY
  CASE x.part
    WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1
    WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2
    WHEN 'the CDS code from my notes' THEN 3

    s.CDSCode,
    s.County
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-15'
    AND f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1
),
qualifying_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.CDSCode,
    ps.County
  FROM poverty_schools ps
  JOIN satscores ss ON ps.CDSCode = ss.cds
  WHERE ss.NumGE1500 >= 1
)
SELECT 
  County as county_name,
  COUNT(*) as num_qualifying_schools
FROM qualifying_schools
GROUP BY County
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY num_qualifying_schools DESC, county_name ASC
LIMIT 1000

WITH
-- 1. Find all sets containing 'Abyssal Horror'
ah_sets AS (
  SELECT c.setCode
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
-- 2. Get release dates for those sets
ah_set_dates AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets s
  JOIN ah_sets a ON s.code = a.setCode
),
-- 3. Get the "first print" set: earliest date, tiebreak on set code
first_printed_set AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM ah_set_dates
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MIN(releaseDate) FROM ah_set_dates)
  ORDER BY code
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 4. Get the most recent set (latest date, tiebreak on code)
recent_set AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
  ORDER BY code
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 5. Pick both set codes
target_sets AS (
  SELECT code FROM first_printed_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT code FROM recent_set
),
-- 6. Get set names
target_set_names AS (
  SELECT ts.code, s.name
  FROM target_sets ts
  JOIN sets s ON ts.code = s.code
),
-- 7. For each target set, count #cards with manaCost (not null/blank) and # of those with convertedManaCost <= 3
set_mana_stats AS (
  SELECT
    tsn.name AS set_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> '' THEN 1 END) AS cards_with_mana_cost,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> '' AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS cheap_cards
  FROM target_set_names tsn
  JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = tsn.code
  GROUP BY tsn.name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(cheap_cards AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(cards_with_mana_cost, 0)
  , 2) AS percent_cheap_cards
FROM set_mana_stats;

treatment.sql:
WITH
abyssal_horror_first_set AS (
  SELECT c.setCode as set_code
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
    AND c.manaCost IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC, s.code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_set AS (
  SELECT s.code as set_code
  FROM sets s
  ORDER BY s.releaseDate DESC, s.code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
selected_sets AS (
  SELECT set_code FROM abyssal_horror_first_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT set_code FROM most_recent_set
),
set_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.code as set_code,
    s.name as set_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as total_with_cost,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 END) as cheap_with_cost
  FROM selected_sets ss
  JOIN sets s ON ss.set_code = s.code
  JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
  GROUP BY s.code, s.name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CASE 
      WHEN total_with_cost = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE 100.0 * cheap_with_cost / total_with_cost
    END, 2
  ) as percent_cheap_cards
FROM set_stats;

  SELECT 
    ta.team_api_id, 
    ta.date AS ta_date, 
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
),
LastFastBuildUpPerMatch AS (
  SELECT 
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    m.date AS match_date,
    MAX(fb.ta_date) AS last_fb_date
  FROM Match m
  JOIN FastBuildUp fb 
    ON fb.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
    AND fb.ta_date <= m.date
  GROUP BY m.id, m.home_team_api_id, m.date
),
QualifiedMatches AS (
  SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN LastFastBuildUpPerMatch lfb 
    ON m.id = lfb.match_id AND m.home_team_api_id = lfb.team_api_id
  JOIN FastBuildUp fb 
    ON fb.team_api_id = lfb.team_api_id AND fb.ta_date = lfb.last_fb_date

),

account_home_pop AS (
    SELECT pr.account_id,
           pr.open_date,
           oi.client_district_id AS home_district_id,
           dist.A2 AS home_district_name,
           dist.A8 AS home_district_population
    FROM pr_account_loans pr
    JOIN owner_info oi ON pr.account_id = oi.account_id
    JOIN district dist ON oi.client_district_id = dist.district_id
),

    SELECT l.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan l
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
counterparties AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT
            CASE
                WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
                     AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != ''
                     AND t.account IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.account != t.account_id
                THEN t.bank || '-' || t.account
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS num_outside_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
final_table AS (
    SELECT
        ahp.account_id,
        ahp.open_date,
        COALESCE(tb.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_borrowed,
        COALESCE(cp.num_outside_counterparties, 0) AS num_outside_counterparties,
        ahp.home_district_id,
        ahp.home_district_name,
        ahp.home_district_population
    FROM account_home_pop ahp
    LEFT JOIN total_borrowed tb ON ahp.account_id = tb.account_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparties cp ON ahp.account_id = cp.account_id
)
SELECT
    ft.account_id,
    ft.open_date,
    ft.total_borrowed,
    ft.num_outside_counterparties,
    ft.home_district_id,
    ft.home_district_name,
    ft.home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY ft.home_district_population DESC, ft.account_id ASC

FROM final_table ft
ORDER BY ft.home_district_population DESC, ft.account_id ASC;

WITH
-- 1. Find Litomerice's district_id (A2 is used as district name per schema), then its co-region districts
litomerice_region_districts AS (
  SELECT d2.district_id, d2.A2 AS district_name
  FROM district d1
  JOIN district d2 ON d1.A3 = d2.A3
  WHERE d1.A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
-- 2. Accounts in those districts opened in 1996
accounts_1996 AS (
  SELECT account_id, district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM litomerice_region_districts)
    AND date >= '1996-01-01' AND date <= '1996-12-31'
),
-- 3. For each account, find the latest transaction id on or before 1996-12-31
last_trans_1996 AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, MAX(t.date) AS last_date
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_1996)
    AND t.date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
final_trans_1996 AS (
  SELECT t1.account_id, t1.trans_id, t1.balance
  FROM trans t1
  JOIN last_trans_1996 lt
    ON t1.account_id = lt.account_id AND t1.date = lt.last_date
  WHERE t1.trans_id = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.trans_id)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.account_id = t1.account_id AND t2.date = t1.date
  )
),
-- 4. Join accounts to these balances
acct_bal AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, f.balance
  FROM accounts_1996 a
  JOIN final_trans_1996 f ON a.account_id = f.account_id
),
-- 5. Stats per district
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.district_name,
    COUNT(ab.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_end_of_1996_balance
  FROM acct_bal ab
  JOIN litomerice_region_districts d ON ab.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.district_name
),
-- 6. Region-wide average
region_stats AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_avg_end_1996_balance
  FROM acct_bal
),
-- 7. Best district by average (alphabetic in case of tie)
top_district AS (
  SELECT district_name, avg_end_of_1996_balance
  FROM district_stats
  WHERE avg_end_of_1996_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_end_of_1996_balance) FROM district_stats)
  ORDER BY district_name
  LIMIT 1
)
-- Final output as requested
SELECT
  ds.district_name,
  ds.num_accounts_opened_1996,
  ds.avg_end_of_1996_balance,
  rs.region_avg_end_1996_balance,
  td.district_name AS highest_avg_balance_district,
  td.avg_end_of_1996_balance AS highest_avg_balance
FROM district_stats ds
CROSS JOIN region_stats rs
CROSS JOIN top_district td
ORDER BY ds.district_name;

WITH british_drivers_post_1980 AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'British' AND CAST(SUBSTR(dob, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1980
),
qualifying_q3 AS (
    SELECT q.qualifyId, q.driverId, q.raceId, q.q3
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN british_drivers_post_1980 b ON q.driverId = b.driverId
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(q.q3) != ''
),
fastest_q3 AS (
    SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN INSTR(q3, ':') > 0 THEN
                        CAST(SUBSTR(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, ':')-1) AS FLOAT) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)
                    ELSE
                        CAST(q3 AS FLOAT)
                    END) AS min_q3_sec
    FROM qualifying_q3
)
SELECT 
    b.full_name AS driver_full_name,
    r.name AS race_name,
    r.year AS race_year,
    q.q3 AS q3_time
FROM qualifying_q3 q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN british_drivers_post_1980 b ON q.driverId = b.driverId
JOIN fastest_q3 f ON (
    CASE WHEN INSTR(q.q3, ':') > 0 THEN
        CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':')-1) AS FLOAT) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)
    ELSE
        CAST(q.q3 AS FLOAT)
    END = f.min_q3_sec
)
ORDER BY r.year, r.name, b.full_name
LIMIT 100

treatment.sql:
WITH british_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, dob
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'British' AND dob > '1980-12-31'
),
q3_times AS (
    SELECT q.qualifyId, q.driverId, q.raceId, q.q3
    FROM qualifying q
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3 <> ''
),
fastest_q3 AS (
    SELECT d.full_name, r.name AS race_name, r.year, q.q3
    FROM q3_times q
    INNER JOIN british_drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    INNER JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE q.q3 REGEXP '^[0-9]+:[0-9][0-9]\.[0-9]+$' -- time format mm:ss.sss
),
fastest_time AS (
    SELECT MIN( (CAST(SUBSTR(q3,1,INSTR(q3,':')-1) AS FLOAT) * 60.0) + CAST(SUBSTR(q3,INSTR(q3,':')+1) AS FLOAT)) AS min_q3_time
    FROM fastest_q3
)
SELECT f.full_name, f.race_name, f.year, f.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM fastest_q3 f
JOIN fastest_time ft ON (CAST(SUBSTR(f.q3,1,INSTR(f.q3,':')-1) AS FLOAT) * 60.0) + CAST(SUBSTR(f.q3,INSTR(f.q3,':')+1) AS FLOAT) = ft.min_q3_time
ORDER BY f.full_name, f.race_name, f.year
LIMIT 100

FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId

    SELECT raceId, milliseconds FROM (
        SELECT raceId, milliseconds, 
               DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceId ORDER BY milliseconds ASC) AS dr
        FROM lapTimes
        WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE dr = 2
) as second_laps ON lt.raceId = second_laps.raceId AND lt.milliseconds = second_laps.milliseconds

  WHERE dob >= '1976-01-01'
),
ranked_laps AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.driverId, r.fastestLapTime,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY r.raceId

             CASE WHEN r.fastestLapTime IS NULL OR r.fastestLapTime = '' THEN NULL ELSE r.fastestLapTime END ASC

)

baseline.sql:
WITH australian_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'Australian'
),
target_seasons AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.year
    FROM seasons s
    JOIN races r ON s.year = r.year
    JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
    WHERE s.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
      AND ds.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM australian_drivers)
      AND ds.position < 21
),
qualifying_races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM target_seasons)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM driverStandings ds
          WHERE ds.raceId = r.raceId
            AND ds.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM australian_drivers)
            AND ds.position < 21
      )
),
count_pitstops AS (
    SELECT qr.year, COUNT(*) AS total_pit_stops
    FROM pitStops ps
    JOIN qualifying_races qr ON ps.raceId = qr.raceId
    GROUP BY qr.year
)
SELECT s.year, IFNULL(cps.total_pit_stops, 0) AS total_pit_stops
FROM seasons s
LEFT JOIN count_pitstops cps ON s.year = cps.year
WHERE s.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
ORDER BY s.year;

),

valid_races AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.raceId
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN aus_driver_ids a ON ds.driverId = a.driverId
    JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
      AND (ds.position IS NOT NULL AND ds.position <= 20)
),

season_pitstops AS (
    SELECT r.year, COUNT(*) AS total_pitstops
    FROM pitStops p
    JOIN races r ON p.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM valid_races)
      AND r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
    GROUP BY r.year
)

SELECT year, total_pitstops
FROM season_pitstops
ORDER BY year
LIMIT 1000

WITH driver_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
        d.nationality,
        d.dob AS dateOfBirth,
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.date AS race_date
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.positionOrder = 1
),
oldest_winner AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        full_name,
        nationality,
        dateOfBirth
    FROM driver_wins
    ORDER BY dateOfBirth ASC, full_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT 
        dw.driverId,
        dw.race_name,
        dw.race_date
    FROM driver_wins dw
    JOIN oldest_winner ow ON dw.driverId = ow.driverId
    ORDER BY dw.race_date ASC, dw.race_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
race_count AS (
    SELECT 
        res.driverId, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) AS total_races_started
    FROM results res
    GROUP BY res.driverId
)
SELECT
    ow.full_name,
    ow.nationality,
    fw.race_name AS first_win_race,
    fw.race_date AS first_win_date,
    rc.total_races_started
FROM oldest_winner ow
JOIN first_win fw ON ow.driverId = fw.driverId
JOIN race_count rc ON ow.driverId = rc.driverId
LIMIT 1;

oldest_dob_winners AS (

  FROM driver_wins dw

),
first_alpha_oldest_winner AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename, surname, nationality, dob

  LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
  SELECT dw.raceId, dw.race_name, dw.race_date
  FROM driver_wins dw
  JOIN first_alpha_oldest_winner ow ON dw.driverId = ow.driverId
  ORDER BY dw.race_date ASC, dw.race_name ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
total_starts AS (
  SELECT res.driverId, COUNT(*) AS starts
  FROM results res
  GROUP BY res.driverId
)
SELECT 
  ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS full_name,
  ow.nationality,
  fw.race_name AS first_win_race,
  fw.race_date AS first_win_date,
  ts.starts AS total_race_starts
FROM first_alpha_oldest_winner ow
JOIN first_win fw
JOIN total_starts ts ON ow.driverId = ts.driverId
LIMIT 1

baseline.sql:
WITH china_2000s AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.date, r.time
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE c.name LIKE '%Shanghai%' AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
),
with_local_datetime AS (
  -- Shanghai, China local time is UTC+8
  SELECT
    *,
    datetime(date || ' ' || COALESCE(time, '14:00:00'), '+8 hours') AS local_start
  FROM china_2000s
),
earliest_local AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    year,
    local_start
  FROM with_local_datetime
  WHERE local_start = (
    SELECT MAX(local_start)
    FROM (
      SELECT local_start
      FROM with_local_datetime
      WHERE local_start = (
        SELECT MIN(local_start)
        FROM with_local_datetime
      )
    )
  )
  -- If several have same earliest, use most recent year (max)
  AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM with_local_datetime WHERE local_start = (SELECT MIN(local_start) FROM with_local_datetime))
),
china_results AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.year,
    res.positionOrder,
    d.code AS driver_code,
    res.time
  FROM earliest_local r
  JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
),

WITH race_times AS (
  SELECT
    races.raceId,
    races.circuitId,
    races.year,
    races.date,
    races.time,
    datetime(races.date || 'T' || COALESCE(races.time, '00:00:00')) as start_datetime
  FROM races
)
, min_max_times AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_datetime) AS earliest_time,
    MAX(start_datetime) AS latest_time
  FROM race_times
)
, circuits_map AS (
  SELECT circuitId, circuitRef FROM circuits
)
SELECT
  'earliest' AS category,
  c.circuitRef,
  r.start_datetime AS start_time
FROM race_times r
JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_datetime = m.earliest_time
JOIN circuits_map c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'latest' AS category,
  c.circuitRef,
  r.start_datetime AS start_time
FROM race_times r
JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_datetime = m.latest_time
JOIN circuits_map c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'gap_seconds' AS category,
  NULL AS circuitRef,
  CAST((strftime('%s', m.latest_time) - strftime('%s', m.earliest_time)) AS TEXT) AS gap_in_seconds
FROM min_max_times m;

WITH races_with_start_seconds AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.circuitId,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    c.circuitRef,
    CAST(strftime('%s', r.date || ' ' || IFNULL(r.time, '00:00:00')) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL -- only consider races with specified start time
),
minmax_times AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_start,
    MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_start
  FROM races_with_start_seconds
),
earliest_circuits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef 
  FROM races_with_start_seconds rwss, minmax_times mmt
  WHERE rwss.start_seconds = mmt.earliest_start
),
latest_circuits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef 
  FROM races_with_start_seconds rwss, minmax_times mmt
  WHERE rwss.start_seconds = mmt.latest_start
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef) FROM earliest_circuits) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef) FROM latest_circuits) AS latest_circuit_refs,
  (SELECT latest_start - earliest_start FROM minmax_times) AS seconds_gap
;

WITH over_budget_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event AS event_id
  FROM budget b
  JOIN expense e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
  WHERE (b.amount - e.cost) < 0
),
relevant_expenses AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.expense_description
  FROM expense e
  WHERE e.link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM over_budget_events ove WHERE ove.event_id = (
        SELECT b.link_to_event FROM budget b WHERE b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
      )
    )
),
itemized_kinds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(item)) AS kind
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN instr(expense_description, ',') > 0 THEN expense_description
        ELSE REPLACE(expense_description, ' and ', ',')
      END AS expense_desc
    FROM relevant_expenses
  ),
  -- Basic splitting on commas
  LATERAL (
    SELECT
      TRIM(value) AS item
    FROM (
      SELECT
        substr(
          expense_desc || ',',
          prev_pos + 1,
          next_pos - prev_pos - 1
        ) AS value,
        next_pos
      FROM (
        SELECT
          expense_desc,
          pos AS prev_pos,
          instr(substr(expense_desc || ',', pos + 1), ',') + pos AS next_pos
        FROM (
          SELECT
            expense_desc,
            0 AS pos
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            instr(expense_desc, ',') AS pos
        )
      )
    )
    WHERE item IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(item) > 0
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) AS count_of_kinds FROM itemized_kinds;

WITH over_budget_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event AS event_id
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount - spent < 0
),
matching_expenses AS (
  SELECT expense_description
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  WHERE b.link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM over_budget_events)
),
split_things AS (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SUBSTR(expense_description, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',') > 0 THEN INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',')-1 ELSE LENGTH(expense_description) END))) AS thing, 
         SUBSTR(expense_description || ',', CASE WHEN INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',') > 0 THEN INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',')+1 ELSE LENGTH(expense_description)+1 END) AS rest
  FROM matching_expenses
  UNION ALL
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SUBSTR(rest, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') > 0 THEN INSTR(rest, ',')-1 ELSE LENGTH(rest) END))) AS thing, 
         SUBSTR(rest, CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') > 0 THEN INSTR(rest, ',')+1 ELSE LENGTH(rest)+1 END)
  FROM split_things
  WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(rest)) > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT thing) AS num_kinds_of_things
FROM split_things
WHERE LENGTH(thing) > 0

water_expense_per_event AS (

        e.event_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(x.cost), 0.0) AS water_expense

)

FROM attended_events ae

ORDER BY ae.event_id

WITH event_budget AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(b.amount),0) AS total_budget
  FROM event e
  LEFT JOIN budget b
    ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  WHERE e.status = 'closed'
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
event_spending AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(exp.cost),0) AS total_spending
  FROM event e
  LEFT JOIN expense exp
    ON e.event_id = exp.link_to_budget
  WHERE e.status = 'closed'
  GROUP BY e.event_id
),
event_purchases AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    COUNT(i.income_id) AS purchases
  FROM event e
  LEFT JOIN income i
    ON e.event_id = i.link_to_member
  WHERE e.status = 'closed'
  GROUP BY e.event_id
),
eligible_events AS (
  SELECT
    eb.event_id,
    eb.event_name,
    ep.purchases
  FROM event_budget eb
  JOIN event_spending es ON eb.event_id = es.event_id
  LEFT JOIN event_purchases ep ON eb.event_id = ep.event_id
  WHERE es.total_spending <= eb.total_budget
)
SELECT event_name
FROM eligible_events
ORDER BY purchases DESC, event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

    TRIM(SUBSTR(d, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(d, ' suspected')>0 THEN INSTR(d, ' suspected')-1 ELSE LENGTH(d)+1 END)) AS diagnosis
  FROM (

    AND a.element IN (SELECT element FROM rare_elements)
),
element_atom_ids AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.element, a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN carcinogenic_rare_molecules crm ON a.element = crm.element AND a.molecule_id = crm.molecule_id
),
bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT ea.molecule_id, ea.element, c.bond_id
  FROM element_atom_ids ea
  JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = ea.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = ea.atom_id
)
SELECT crm.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ba.bond_id) AS rare_element_bond_count
FROM carcinogenic_rare_molecules crm
JOIN bonded_atoms ba ON ba.molecule_id = crm.molecule_id AND ba.element = crm.element
GROUP BY crm.molecule_id
ORDER BY crm.molecule_id

WITH molecule_atoms AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id AS molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        SUM(a.element = 'C') AS carbon_count,
        SUM(a.element = 'Cl') AS chlorine_count
    FROM molecule m
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT
        b.bond_id,
        b.molecule_id,
        b.bond_type,
        MIN(a.atom_id) AS atom1_id,
        MAX(a.atom_id) AS atom2_id
    FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    GROUP BY b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
),
carbon_bonds AS (
    SELECT
        ba.molecule_id,
        ba.bond_id,
        ba.bond_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.atom_id = ba.atom1_id OR a.atom_id = ba.atom2_id THEN a.element = 'C' ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_in_bond
    FROM bond_atoms ba
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = ba.molecule_id
    GROUP BY ba.molecule_id, ba.bond_id, ba.bond_type
),
molecule_bonds AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count,
        SUM(bond_type IN ('double', 'triple', 'aromatic')) AS multiple_bond_count,
        SUM(carbon_in_bond > 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count
    FROM carbon_bonds
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT
    ma.molecule_id,
    ma.carcinogenicity_label,
    ma.atom_count,
    COALESCE(mb.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count,
    ma.carbon_count,
    ma.chlorine_count,
    COALESCE(mb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
    COALESCE(mb.multiple_bond_count, 0) AS multiple_bond_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY 
            COALESCE(mb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC,
            ma.atom_count DESC,
            ma.molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank_position
FROM molecule_atoms ma
LEFT JOIN molecule_bonds mb ON ma.molecule_id = mb.molecule_id
WHERE ma.carbon_count > 0
ORDER BY 
    carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, 
    atom_count DESC, 
    ma.molecule_id ASC
;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'Yttrium' LIMIT 1
)
AND (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM atom
        WHERE atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
        AND atom.atom_id = substr(bond.bond_id, 1, instr(bond.bond_id, '-')-1)
        AND atom.element = 'Hydrogen'
    )
    OR
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM atom
        WHERE atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
        AND atom.atom_id = substr(bond.bond_id, instr(bond.bond_id, '-')+1)
        AND atom.element = 'Hydrogen'
    )
)

WITH double_triple_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    b.bond_type,
    a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS element1,
    a2.atom_id AS atom2_id, a2.element AS element2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND a1.atom_id < a2.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label IS NULL OR label NOT LIKE '%carcinogen%'
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN element1 = 'C' THEN element2 ELSE element1 END AS element,
  COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM double_triple_bonds db
JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules nm ON db.molecule_id = nm.molecule_id
WHERE (element1 = 'C' OR element2 = 'C')
  AND element1 != element2
GROUP BY element

WITH mol_info AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, label as carcinogenicity_label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
),
filtered_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
        ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element
      END
    ) AS num_element_pairs
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id AND b.bond_id LIKE a1.atom_id || '%'
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id AND b.bond_id LIKE '%' || a2.atom_id
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('single', 'double')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  f.bond_kind_symbol,
  f.num_bonds,
  f.num_element_pairs,
  m.carcinogenicity_label
FROM filtered_bonds f
CROSS JOIN mol_info m
ORDER BY
  f.num_bonds DESC,
  f.bond_kind_symbol ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label NOT LIKE '%carcinogenic%'
  AND a.element IN ('Li','Be','Na','Mg','Al','K','Ca','Sc','Ti','V','Cr','Mn','Fe','Co','Ni','Cu','Zn','Ga','Rb','Sr','Y','Zr','Nb','Mo','Tc','Ru','Rh','Pd','Ag','Cd','In','Sn','Cs','Ba','La','Hf','Ta','W','Re','Os','Ir','Pt','Au','Hg','Tl','Pb','Bi','Fr','Ra','Ac','Rf','Db','Sg','Bh','Hs','Mt','Ds','Rg','Cn','Fl','Lv','Ts','Og')
  AND b.bond_type = 'single'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH saturated_atoms AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    a.element
  FROM
    atom a
    JOIN bond b ON a.atom_id = b.atom1_id OR a.atom_id = b.atom2_id
  GROUP BY
    a.atom_id,
    a.element
  HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
    AND COUNT(*) >= 1
)
SELECT
  element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(*) AS saturated_atom_count
FROM
  saturated_atoms
GROUP BY
  element
ORDER BY
  element_symbol ASC;

WITH triple_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, a.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = 'triple'
)
SELECT
  element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM triple_bond_atoms
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;
